title: Crew Common Definitions
description: Shared identifiers, closed enums and error codes for the crew domain (CREW-11, design: Crews v1 sections 1-3). A crew is a named set of agents that cooperate on one job; a fleet is all agents of a project. IDENTIFIERS vs CONTENT: crew_id, crew_revision_id, role_id, role_token and crew_run_id are server-issued or SDK-minted opaque identifiers (x-identifier) and are the only crew values that may appear in traces, baggage, optimizer parameter keys or Director inputs. crew_key, name, description and role_key are CONTENT (x-content + x-privacy-classification user_content): they live in crew tables and the portal only. Every string pattern ends with the portable end anchor (?![\s\S]) (see agents/agent_version_manifest_v1_schema.json for why).

CrewId.description: Opaque, immutable, server-issued crew id: 'crew_' + lowercase hex.

CrewRevisionId.description: Opaque server-issued crew revision id: 'crev_' + lowercase hex.

CrewRoleId.description: Opaque server-issued role id, stable across revisions: 'crol_' + lowercase hex.

RoleToken.description: Opaque server-issued role token, unique within a crew: 'rtk_' + 26 lowercase unpadded base32 chars (128 random bits). A single underscore never forms '__'; the joint-optimization key '<role_token>__<param>' is split on the FIRST '__'. This is the only role label allowed on traces, baggage and smartopt keys; the customer's role_key never leaves the crew tables.

CrewRunId.description: SDK-minted UUIDv7 (lowercase) identifying one end-to-end crew run; unique per tenant, project and crew.

AgentId.description: Existing project agent id (agents/agent_schema.json#/properties/id). Client-supplied, therefore CONTENT for Director inputs and exports (GNFR-PRIV-003): exports use the backend agent_ref instead.

CrewKey.description: Immutable registration key; the idempotency key of create-crew. CONTENT. Same rules as agent_key (BE src/models/agent.py AGENT_KEY_PATTERN, ForeignKeyId): [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}, case-sensitive, unique among ACTIVE crews per project (per creator on the default tenant), reusable after archive; unarchive is 409 crew_key_conflict while an active crew holds the key.

RoleKey.description: Customer alias of a role (portal only). CONTENT. Identity is role_id/role_token, never role_key.

BindingKind.description: agent = a whole project agent; agent_unit = an in-function unit (reserved, slice 4).

HaltReason.description: Closed reason a crew run was halted by policy.

RunCompleteness.description: Whether every expected member execution and handoff was ingested.

ExperimentRunId.description: Server-issued experiment run id: lowercase UUID, the backend's real id shape (BE src/models/experiment_run.py id = str(uuid.uuid4()), String(100)). Content (names, agent ids) can never match.

ConfigurationRunId.description: Server-issued configuration run id: lowercase UUID (BE src/models/configuration_run.py:37 id = str(uuid.uuid4())).

ScenarioRef.description: Server-issued scenario reference only; never a customer example id or label.

RoleIcon.description: Closed icon vocabulary (documented in the domain README).

CrewErrorCode.description: Closed error vocabulary. crew_binding_conflict (409) = a binding contradicts an existing binding (same revision/role bound to a different agent, or an agent already bound to the same role differently). The error body never echoes client-supplied keys or values.
